name: stealthwatch_api_call
description: Call Cisco Stealthwatch Enterprise REST API. Blast radius: GET=low, POST/PUT=medium, config paths=high, DELETE=destructive. Always retrieve tenantId first via GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants before making other calls.

function.name: stealthwatch_api_call
function.description:
Call Cisco Stealthwatch Enterprise (Secure Network Analytics) REST API.

GENERAL PATTERN (read this before guessing endpoints):
- Every data path is under /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/... so ALWAYS get the tenantId first via GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants.
- Reads like hosts/host-groups are a single GET.
- Security-events and flows are NOT a single GET. They are ASYNC: POST a query to .../queries to start a search job, then GET .../results/{queryId} and poll until the results array is populated. Do NOT brute-force singular/plural endpoint names; if a path 404s it is the wrong SHAPE, switch to the query/poll pattern.
- Query filter bodies accept ONLY documented keys; unknown keys (startTime, endTime, limit, searchName, ...) return 400 BAD_REQUEST_UNMARSHALING_FAILED.

BLAST RADIUS TIERS:
- low: GET operations (read-only, auto-allowed)
- medium: POST/PUT queries, non-destructive writes
- high: Configuration changes (tags, policies, custom security events)
- destructive: DELETE operations

TENANT INFO (low):
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants
    Get tenants. Payload: {"data": [{"id": 301, "displayName": "..."}]}

SECURITY-EVENT TYPES (the CATALOG of event types — a SINGLE GET, not async):
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/security-events/templates        (low)
    Use this for 'what security-event types exist'. Returns {"data": [{"id", "name", "description"}]} (~100 types e.g. SYN Flood, Host Lock Violation). There is NO /sw-reporting/v1/security-event-types (that 404s).

SECURITY EVENTS (async query -> poll -> results):
  POST /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/security-events/queries        (medium)
    Start a security-event search. Body filter keys (ALL optional except timeRange):
      timeRange: {"from": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ", "to": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ"}
      alarmCategoryId: int
      hosts: ["ip-or-range"]
      securityEventTypeIds: [int]
    Returns: {"data": {"searchJob": {"id": "<queryId>", "searchJobStatus": "IN_PROGRESS", "percentComplete": 0}}}
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/security-events/results/{queryId}   (low)
    Poll for results (sleep ~2s between polls). When ready:
      {"data": {"results": [{"id", "securityEventType", "firstActiveTime", "lastActiveTime", "source": {"ipAddress",...}, "target": {"ipAddress",...}, "details": [{"key","value"}]}]}}

FLOWS (same async query -> poll -> results pattern):
  POST /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/flows/queries        (medium)
    Body: {timeRange: {from, to}, ...flow filters}. Returns a searchJob id.
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/flows/results/{queryId}   (low)
    Poll until results populated.

HOSTS & INVENTORY (low):
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/hosts
    List monitored hosts. Optional query: filter
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/host-groups
    Configured host groups
  GET /sw-reporting/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/hosts/{hostId}
    Detail for one host

CONFIGURATION (high):
  POST /smc-configuration/rest/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/tags
    Create a tag. Body: {name, ranges: ["CIDR"], description}
  PUT  /smc-configuration/rest/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/tags/{id}
    Update a tag. Body: {name, ranges, description}
  POST /smc-configuration/rest/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/custom-security-events
    Create custom security event rule. Body: {name, conditions, severity, actions}

DESTRUCTIVE (destructive):
  DELETE /smc-configuration/rest/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/tags/{id}
    Permanently delete a tag
  DELETE /smc-configuration/rest/v1/tenants/{tenantId}/custom-security-events/{id}
    Permanently delete a custom security event rule

query_params.description: URL query parameters as key-value pairs (optional)
